title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - Device
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/Device. Details with respect to properties and capabilities of a hardware or virtualized device. The source ontology treats this as an abstract root class with subclasses CPU, Disk, GPU, and Memory; included here per the full-ontology translation scope.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Device'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

generation.description: Property. Vendor-specific generation of the device.

defaultOversubscriptionRatio.description: Property. Default over-subscription ratio for virtual machines (1 = no over-subscription).

supportedOversubscriptionRatio.description: Property. Supported over-subscription ratio for virtual machines (1 = no over-subscription).
